# 5-Day Lisbon Family Itinerary: Apr 10–14, 2026

A relaxed Lisbon plan for 2 adults + 1 child, built around museums, easy walks, one beach day, and built-in rest. Costs are estimated for the full group and kept within your **€1,800** budget excluding flights.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Plan

## Day 1 — Baixa, Chiado & Riverside Welcome
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and take a gentle orientation walk through **Baixa** and **Rossio**.
- Afternoon: Visit **Carmo Archaeological Museum** or the **Lisbon Story Centre** for an easy first museum stop.
- Rest break: Coffee + pastel de nata pause in **Chiado**; return to the hotel for a short reset before dinner.
- Food: Lunch at a casual tasca; dinner with grilled fish or chicken piri-piri near the river.
- Estimated cost: **€210**
  - Museum tickets: €25
  - Meals/snacks: €110
  - Local transport: €15
  - Miscellaneous: €60

## Day 2 — Alfama, Tram Ride & Tile Museum
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Ride tram or taxi up to **Alfama** and do a slow walk with scenic viewpoints.
- Afternoon: Visit the **National Tile Museum** for a child-friendly, visually engaging museum visit.
- Rest break: Long lunch and a quiet stop at a café before heading back; keep the afternoon light.
- Food: Lunch near Alfama with soup, sandwiches, or codfish cakes; dinner in central Lisbon.
- Estimated cost: **€225**
  - Museum tickets: €30
  - Tram/transport: €20
  - Meals/snacks: €120
  - Miscellaneous: €55

## Day 3 — Belém Classics Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Start early at **Jerónimos Monastery** and the **Belém Tower** area.
- Afternoon: Add the **Coach Museum** or **MAAT** if energy is good; otherwise keep it to a riverside walk and bakery stop.
- Rest break: Sit-down lunch and a mid-afternoon café break to avoid overloading the day.
- Food: Pastéis de Belém for a snack; lunch near the waterfront; simple dinner back in town.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/4c/Lisbon_%281600%29_detail_1.jpg Alt=Food: Pastéis de Belém for a snack; lunch near the waterfront; simple dinner back in town, Lisbon, Portugal
- Estimated cost: **€260**
  - Tickets: €45
  - Transport: €20
  - Meals/snacks: €135
  - Miscellaneous: €60

## Day 4 — Beach Day in Cascais
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Train to **Cascais** and settle in for a calm beach morning.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=Morning: Train to **Cascais** and settle in for a calm beach morning, Lisbon, Portugal
- Afternoon: Light seaside stroll, playground time, or a short harbor walk; keep it flexible and low-effort.
- Rest break: Beach chairs or a long café lunch in town; head back before the evening rush.
- Food: Seafood lunch by the water; easy dinner in Lisbon after returning.
- Estimated cost: **€280**
  - Train/local transit: €25
  - Beach extras: €20
  - Meals/snacks: €155
  - Miscellaneous: €80

## Day 5 — Museum Choice + Final Stroll
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- Morning: Choose one final museum based on energy: **Calouste Gulbenkian Museum** for art or **National Coach Museum** for something more kid-friendly.
- Afternoon: Free time for souvenir shopping, a slow park walk, or one last viewpoint.
- Rest break: Early lunch and a relaxed hotel pause before packing.
- Food: Brunch or lunch in a café; farewell dinner with a simple Portuguese meal.
- Estimated cost: **€190**
  - Tickets: €20
  - Meals/snacks: €110
  - Transport: €15
  - Miscellaneous: €45

## Budget Fit for 2 Adults + 1 Child

| Category | Estimated Total |
|---|---:|
| Accommodation | €650 |
| Food & drinks | €630 |
| Local transport | €90 |
| Tickets & activities | €220 |
| Miscellaneous buffer | €140 |
| **Trip total** | **€1,730** |

## Pace and Planning Notes

- This plan keeps you at **2 major activities max per day**.
- Most days include a **midday rest break** or café pause.
- The beach day is intentionally lighter to balance museum days.
- If you want to reduce cost further, the easiest savings are on museum choices, taxis, and one upgraded dinner.
